signal_evidence.capex_direction: We have placed deposits and issued purchase orders on main power transformers and circuit breakers for the first phase of that [830MW] development and have secured capacity for the balance of long-lead electrical infrastructure.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: Our headline rent number with CoreWeave is a standout in the market... on an after-financing cost basis, the economics to us, both on a dollar and on an IRR basis to build for this next capacity, is going to be equally attractive.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: So far in Q2, we have seen an improvement in digital asset prices and overall activity. This has translated into a strong start to the quarter for Galaxy, with second quarter-to-date adjusted EBITDA estimated at approximately $90 million through last Friday.
